name: null-walked-into-is-not-written-back
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): Ruling 12: lat (7.1) and lon (7.2) pass through null at 7: they are absent, and the null is walked into, not residue, so 07f6 is not written back. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
